articles.title: Ripple stablecoin chief sees $13 trillion corporate treasury opportunity for RLUSD
articles.snippet: Payments and capital markets are driving growth for Ripple's $2.4 billion digital dollar as it looks to bring RLUSD to Europe under MiCA, the firm's Jack McDonald said.

articles.title: Anchorage Digital adds institutional access to Frgmnt’s fUSD stablecoin
articles.snippet: The US federally chartered crypto bank will allow institutional clients to hold, mint, redeem and stake Frgmnt’s fUSD stablecoin through its custody platform.

articles.title: UK House of Lords backs mandatory digital asset strategy over Labour position
articles.snippet: The amendment would require the UK Treasury to develop a strategy covering cryptoassets, stablecoins, tokenized securities and digital financial infrastructure.

articles.title: MoneyGram launches Visa stablecoin card as remittance rivals expand
articles.snippet: MoneyGram is following rival Western Union’s lead, rolling out a Visa stablecoin debit card as it expands blockchain-based payments.

articles.title: Coinbase, Moov to provide stablecoin infrastructure for US community banks
articles.snippet: The partnership will provide stablecoin acceptance, settlement and real-time funding capabilities to over 1,000 community banks and credit unions.
